items.title: Recognize managed global-thin projects as activity-log writable roots
items.context: The heartbeat child process can run session_brief in a global-thin project, but cli-engine writeLog currently gates activity logging on hasProjectConfigFile(), whose config filename set only includes lattice.config.json. Add an explicit helper for runtime/log root detection that accepts .lattice/lattice.json with assetMode global-thin without teaching loadConfig() to parse that file as canonical project config.

items.title: Cover canonical and global-thin activity logging behavior with regression tests
items.context: Add focused regression or smoke coverage proving canonical lattice.config.json projects still log activity, global-thin managed projects log activity, and unrelated directories do not become project roots accidentally.
